rationale: theme-backfill (lane L8, 2026-10-02, coordinator ruling per CLAUDE.md rule 17 'nothing in this build runs alone'): a one-time/re-runnable data-correction harness over a defined candidate set (research_finding rows with theme IS NULL) rather than a standing producer. Governing files are backfill-themes.mjs (the classification + patch logic) and metadata-vocab.ts (the DB_THEME_VALUE_LIST single home it classifies against) - a change to either changes what a run means, so both move the harness_version hash.
